recs.stt: Ask HN: Favorite teachers on YouTube?
recs.x: One of my favorite video series on YouTube is Francis Su's _Real Analysis_. [link] He walks through the basics of constructing the real numbers, defines metric spaces and proves some topological properties, defines continuous functions, and goes into differentiable functions.
